svg.title: Line-Scan Hyperspectral 3D Gaussian Splatting
svg.desc: An SO-101 robot arm carries a pushbroom spectrograph. A scan mirror sweeps a line of light across a potted plant; behind the line the plant turns into colored 3D Gaussians, and one Gaussian's stored spectrum is shown in a callout.

g.text: A pushbroom spectrograph rides an SO-101 arm,
and every Gaussian in the splat stores a spectrum.

svg.text: * geometric, with ideal lenses (Optiland model); real M12 lenses will land around 5–8 nm
